reason: Current canonical implementations substantiate the baseline input-layer purpose, data flow, state transitions and reset integration. Conversion and filtering are configuration-dependent; the error-clearing description is qualified by the explicitly documented -3 exception. Copy and game publication each derive their own edges and repeats. Reset latching occurs when polling is reached, and remains sticky during normal operation until explicit reset; initialization also restores defaults. These qualifications do not change the retained functional descriptions.
